name: Long March 2D
location_str: Launch Area 94 (SLS-2 / 603) @ Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: Launch Area 94 (SLS-2 / 603) has flown 139 launches since its first in 2003, 8 of them this year. Its previous launch was 18 days earlier.
slot_b_text: Launch pad water deluge systems reduce the intense acoustic and pressure waves produced at liftoff, protecting the rocket and launch pad.
